title: Getting Started
subtitle: Your first day in the forest

quests.title: Welcome, Friend
text: Welcome to Friends of the Forest! These quests walk you through the pack one step at a time.
Tick this off to start. Rewards are claimed from the quest window.

quests.title: Read the Field Guide
text: You started with the Field Guide. It explains everything the pack adds. Lost it? Type /guide for a new one.
Have a look at the Getting Started pages, then tick this off.

quests.title: Timber!
text: Every journey starts with a tree. Chop some logs; any wood counts once you have four of one kind.

quests.title: Skills
text: Almost everything you do earns skill XP: mining, farming, cooking, fighting, taming and more.
Press K to open your skill trees and spend points on perks.

quests.title: Pack Your Bags
text: A backpack gives you a lot more room. Wear it and press B to open it.

quests.title: You've Got Mail
text: Craft a mailbox and give it an ID. Friends send letters and packages to that ID, and a mail carrier brings them.

quests.title: A Place to Sleep
text: Make a bed and sleep through your first night.

quests.title: Neighbours
text: Villages are full of people with problems. Find one, then sneak and right-click villagers to talk to them: some have quests for you.
